context: Tests whether the agent creates a Git worktree using the correct naming convention, discovers the repository's real integration target rather than assuming main or master, creates a named task branch, verifies the setup post-creation, and produces a completion report with the required fields.

checklist.name: Correct worktree location
checklist.description: The worktree is created at a path matching `myproject/.worktrees/add-config-validation` — i.e., follows the `<primary-root>/.worktrees/<task>` convention with the task name as the final segment

checklist.name: Correct base branch
checklist.description: The task branch or worktree is rooted from `develop`, NOT from `main` or `master` — verifiable from the `worktree-setup.md` report or from the worktree's git history

checklist.name: Task branch created
checklist.description: A named task branch (not a detached HEAD) is created in the worktree for development work — the branch name is visible in `worktree-setup.md`

checklist.name: Post-creation worktree list
checklist.description: `worktree-setup.md` includes output from `git worktree list` (or `--porcelain`) run after the worktree was created, showing the new checkout is registered

checklist.name: HEAD commit verified
checklist.description: `worktree-setup.md` includes the output of `git rev-parse HEAD` or the literal HEAD commit hash of the new worktree, confirming the commit was verified after creation

checklist.name: Report: absolute path
checklist.description: `worktree-setup.md` includes the absolute path of the created worktree (not a relative path)

checklist.name: Report: branch name
checklist.description: `worktree-setup.md` explicitly names the task branch that is checked out in the worktree

checklist.name: Report: registration confirmed
checklist.description: `worktree-setup.md` states that the worktree registration was confirmed (e.g. by referencing `git worktree list` output or explicitly noting the worktree is registered)
